GodMode Rules and Instructions:
# Ishant5436 — Submission Standard v1.0
**Status:** Active  
**Applies to:** Every PR, comment, commit, and issue interaction

---

## The Core Rule

A reviewer should not be able to tell you are a student, that AI was involved,
or that this is a bounty submission. It should look like a senior engineer
who knows this codebase closing a ticket they opened themselves.

---

## 1. Commit Messages

Follow Conventional Commits exactly. One subject line, max 72 chars.
Body is optional but used when the *why* is not obvious from the diff.

```
<type>(<scope>): <imperative verb> <what>

[optional body — the WHY, not the WHAT]

[optional footer: Fixes #N, Closes #N, BREAKING CHANGE: ...]
```

**Allowed types:** `feat`, `fix`, `test`, `refactor`, `docs`, `chore`, `perf`, `ci`

**Good:**
```
fix(dialyzer): pin PLT cache key to OTP and Elixir versions
feat(escrow): extract refund logic into composable IRefundPolicy interface
test(quoter): add property-based coverage for strategy edge cases
refactor(pool): remove dead branch in fee accumulation path
```

**Bad (never do this):**
```
Added some fixes
feat: Implemented the Uniswap V3 thing
WIP: testing stuff
fix: fixed bug
Initial implementation
```

---

## 2. Branch Naming

```
<type>/<issue-number>-<short-slug>

feat/78-uniswap-v3-liquidity
fix/18-dialyzer-plt-cache
test/29-quoter-strategy-coverage
```

---

## 3. PR Title

Same format as the commit message on the squash-merge commit.
Must reference the issue. No emoji. No "Bounty Submission" in the title.

**Good:**
```
feat(lux): add Coinbase Exchange integration (closes #83)
fix(dialyzer): pin PLT cache to OTP/Elixir version pair (fixes #18)
test(quoter): add property-based strategy coverage (fixes #29)
```

**Bad:**
```
[BOUNTY] Coinbase Integration 🚀
Fix issue 83
feat: Implement the thing requested in #83
```

---

## 4. PR Body Template

```markdown
## Summary

One or two sentences. What this PR does and why. Past tense.
Not "This PR aims to..." — state what it *does*.

## Changes

- `path/to/file.ex`: added X to handle Y
- `path/to/test_file.exs`: unit coverage for X
- `docs/migration.md`: documented breaking change in Z

## Testing

- `mix test path/to/specific_test.exs` — all pass
- Manual: called endpoint with X, received expected Y
- Edge case: nil input returns {:error, :invalid_input}

## Notes

[Omit entirely if nothing non-obvious to add.]
```

---

## 5. Prohibited Words — 43-Entry Table

| Prohibited | Use Instead |
|---|---|
| leverage | use |
| utilize | use |
| robust | reliable, stable |
| seamless | smooth, direct |
| cutting-edge | recent, current |
| state-of-the-art | (just describe it) |
| streamline | simplify, reduce |
| comprehensive | full, complete |
| innovative | (just describe what's new) |
| pivotal | critical, key |
| Moreover / Furthermore | (start next sentence directly) |
| Additionally | (start next sentence directly) |
| ensure | confirm, verify, check |
| seamlessly integrates | works with, connects to |
| delve into | examine, look at |
| embark on | start, begin |
| testament to | shows, proves |
| foster | build, support |
| facilitate | help, allow, enable |
| in the context of | for, in |
| This PR aims to | This PR adds / fixes / removes |
| I hope this helps | (omit) |
| feel free to | (omit) |
| Let me know if any questions | (omit) |
| As per the issue | (just describe what was done) |

| it should be noted | (just state the fact) |

| synergy | (never) |
| holistic | (never) |

---

## 6. Code Quality Gates

**Must-have before opening PR:**
- [ ] Every public function has a doc comment
- [ ] No commented-out code in the diff
- [ ] No debug output left in (`IO.inspect`, `console.log`, `print`, `dbg`)
- [ ] Error paths handled explicitly, not with catch-all
- [ ] Tests in the correct directory, using repo's existing helpers
- [ ] Rebased on latest main before opening
- [ ] No unrelated files changed (no stray formatting diffs)
- [ ] No hardcoded localhost URLs or dev-only config

**Instant rejection signals:**
- Mixing two features in one PR
- Tests only covering the happy path
- Magic strings without constants
- Copying code instead of importing/reusing
- Adding dependencies not in the project's approved list
- Ignoring linter output (`# noqa`, `// eslint-disable`, `@suppress`)

---

## 7. Commenting on Issues (Before Starting Work)

Post one comment. Keep it under 4 lines.

```
Planning to address this by [one sentence on approach].
ETA: [realistic estimate, e.g., "48 hours"].
```

Do not write:
- "Hi! I am interested in this bounty!"
- "I would love to help with this amazing project!"
- Long self-introductions or skill lists

---

## 8. Responding to Review Feedback

Reply with what you *changed*, not what you *plan* to change.

**Good:**
```
Fixed in abc1234. Changed return type from list to tuple
to match the pattern in PoolStatePrism.
```

**Bad:**
```
Thanks for the feedback! I've made some changes as suggested.
Please let me know if this looks good now!
```

---

## 9. PR Size Targets

| Size | Lines | Strategy |
|---|---|---|
| Small | < 200 | Ideal. Reviews in < 1 day. |
| Medium | 200–600 | Acceptable for complex features. |
| Large | 600–1500 | Add clear justification in summary. |
| Too large | > 1500 | Split into stacked PRs. |

---

## 10. Pre-Open Checklist

```
[ ] Branch name: <type>/<issue>-<slug>
[ ] PR title: conventional commit format, issue referenced
[ ] PR body: Summary + Changes + Testing all filled
[ ] Prohibited words: none present
[ ] Diff: rebased on latest main
[ ] Debug output: none
[ ] Tests: exist, pass locally
[ ] Unrelated changes: none
[ ] "Bounty" / "submission": not in title
```

---
